items.title: A graph theory approach to chart the architecture of dream and mind-wandering reports
items.author: Tristan Andres Bekinschtein
items.content: This study applies graph theory analysis to a large dataset of dream and mind wandering reports. It repoerts distinct narrative structures, stable individual patterns and relationships between lower lexical diversity and depression and anxiety symptoms.
